ShortDescription.Value: Explore your city on foot and ride public transit. First-person camera included; no separate FPC required.

Publish.LongDescription:
Explore the city you built — on foot.
Real Walking adds pedestrian-aware first-person walking, stairs and station exploration, public transport rides and independent free flight to Cities: Skylines II. Press Alt+F to enter first person at the closest suitable walkable surface to your camera. Follow roads, bridges, station platforms and navigation areas, with automatic height tracking and path boundary handling.
Ride stopped buses, trams, metro and passenger trains, ferries and passenger ships. Press E near a stopped vehicle to board, then leave at a suitable stop when a safe walking surface is available. A route and stop display appears while riding.
CONTROLS Alt+F: Enter / leave first person WASD + Mouse: Move / look Shift: Move faster on foot E: Board or disembark when allowed Ctrl+Shift+J: Navigation walking / free flight R / F: Raise / lower flight altitude Ctrl+Shift+V: Toggle navigation debug overlays Esc: Exit first person
STANDALONE CAMERA INCLUDED First Person Camera Continued is built into this edition. Do not enable a separate FPC Continued or another conflicting first-person camera mod in the same playset. Restart the game after changing camera mods.
COMPATIBILITY Tested with Cities: Skylines II 1.6.x on Windows. Some custom stations, unusual paths and waterfront assets lack suitable navigation geometry, so not every surface or vehicle exit is supported. Entering walking mode while the simulation is paused may fail to find a correct landing; resume the simulation before pressing Alt+F. The mod does not intentionally modify saved city entities or traffic AI; back up important saves as with any code mod.
SOURCE AND CREDITS Full source (GPLv2), development history and issue reporting: https://github.com/brianperezjct33/RealWalking-CS2
Embedded camera adapted from First Person Camera Continued by Cgameworld and earlier contributors. This is a community project, not an official Colossal Order / Paradox Interactive mod. Developed with substantial AI coding assistance and maintainer-directed in-game testing.
